currentClosedLobeBoundReview.scope: Current three primary closed lobes at the reported stations only. Static constructor hash unchanged, unit radial normals, aForm=min(.17,rx*.22,rz*.22), total radial shader clamp and unchanged extra vertical formula. Rounding tolerance 0.1mm. Does not cover veil/droplet/fragments, unreported stations, actual ring-angle contact or visual continuity; this is a bound check, not a literal diff against unavailable r3 shader source.

low.scope: Lower tier frozen B r3 conservative bounds only, compared with actual C rock at ring-centre horizontal Y slices. X uses reported nominal rx plus radial dynamic bound. Z extrema and X extrema need not occur at the same ring angle/phase; tilted ring vertical span is not reconstructed. Negative gap is potential bound overlap, not certified actual water-mesh penetration; positive slices do not certify complete dynamics.
